citations.text:
The used architecture of the QA model is briefly summarized below. Here we choose QANet BIBREF2
as the base model due to the following reasons: 1) it achieves the second best performance on SQuAD,
and 2) since there are completely no recurrent networks in QANet, its training speed is 5x faster than
BiDAF BIBREF17 when reaching the same performance on SQuAD.
